def number_to_string(number, significant_digits, number_format_notation='f'):
    if number_format_notation not in number_formatting:
        raise ValueError("number_format_notation must be 'f' or 'e'")
    
    fmt = number_formatting[number_format_notation] % significant_digits
    
    if isinstance(number, complex):
        result = fmt.format(number.real) + '+' + fmt.format(number.imag) + 'j'
        return result
    
    type_name = type(number).__name__
    return '{}:{}'.format(type_name, fmt.format(number))
